on_screen_text.text: MAYOR ZOHRAN MAMDANI, CARDI B TEAM UP TO LAUNCH JINGLE CONTEST FOR FREE CHILD CARE PROGRAM
Get ready, New York. @iamcardib will be judging YOUR jingles to help spread the word about universal childcare for 2 year olds — aka 2-K.
Submit your song by April 17. Full guidelines at nyc.gov/jingle.
(Tag #NYC2KJingle and @nycmayor if you post your jingle on social media.)
